said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
Donald Trump’s Big Ugly Bill is making health care more expensive for millions of Americans.

Here in Massachusetts, premiums have already gone up 38% in recent years. And families are about to get hit with another increase.

When @HouseDemocrats take the majority in January, we will vote to reverse these cuts, bring down costs, and fix our broken healthcare system. No family should have to choose between putting food on the table and seeing a doctor.

https://t.co/0FSsHeVExf

My husband and I have taken our young children to the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, one of the most solemn sites honoring to our nation’s servicemembers. Not a single one of them was reprimanded by the soldier guarding the tomb. https://t.co/EOK8BvWz1S

When a young man or woman makes the courageous decision to join our Armed Forces, they make a promise to serve, to sacrifice, and to defend the rights and freedoms we value as Americans.

We owe them a promise in return. We owe it to them to have their backs both while they serve https://t.co/RDGeiJxkjq

Strong AI safety guardrails are the bare minimum Congress should pass.
 We also need significant investments in our cyber infrastructure and resiliency as bad actors seek to use AI systems to commit crimes.

Doing nothing isn’t an option.

https://t.co/VL1VgaCEfO

Donald Trump’s reaction to losing the midterms in historic fashion?

Elevate the advisor responsible for his most heinous and unpopular policies. https://t.co/FFLAJSCWp3

I never planned on running for public office, but that changed after Donald Trump was elected in 2016. I felt like I had to get off the sidelines and show my daughters that there’s nothing they can’t do.

Now, they’ll have 117 (and counting!) incredible women in Congress to look

Lower costs. End the chaos. Eliminate the corruption.

It’s a new day, and we’ve got a lot of work to do.

It’s Election Day, Massachusetts!

Haven’t voted yet? Polling places are open until 8:00 PM.

Haven’t returned your mail-in ballot? You CANNOT drop it off at a polling place. Find a drop box near you at https://t.co/mpDRB879ka 

Make your voice heard today, and encourage your friends and neighbors to do the same. Happy voting!

Hopefully this reporting is mandatory in the near future, but until then it's entirely reasonable for AI companies to keep Congress apprised as we work on much needed oversight.
 
Grateful to @FrankPallone, @RepZoeLofgren and @RepRaskin for their efforts to ensure Congress has the information we need to do our jobs.

Ban members of Congress from trading stocks. Extend that ban to the President, Vice President, their families, Cabinet members and staff.

No federal policymakers should be able to use their power to line their own pockets.

https://t.co/JxbJBEOLOp

Dolores Huerta changed the course of our country. She spent her life organizing workers, fighting for farmworkers’ rights, and demanding for people often overlooked and left behind.  She didn't do it from the sidelines. She didn't do it for power. She did it because it was the right thing to do. Dolores believed every worker deserved a seat at the table, every family deserved a fair shot, and every person deserved to be heard.  Dolores Huerta built a movement that changed countless lives and opened doors for generations to come.

For four decades, the MIT @MediaLab has challenged boundaries, taking on questions once considered out of reach for humans and technology alike.

It was an honor to celebrate the lab’s 40th anniversary today and discuss what the future of our Democracy looks like in the age of https://t.co/u9z5HmZfiF

Today, the NSA warned organizations to patch two critical security flaws in PHP or take their systems offline. PHP is the software behind roughly 7 in 10 websites, from small business storefronts to town, school and government portals.
 
Attackers began exploiting these flaws https://t.co/CY9I6tEDUS

Today, our Lowell office was one of many congressional and election offices across the country that received a suspicious letter containing a potential threat. I’m grateful to the Lowell Fire Department, Lowell Police Department and FBI. They responded quickly, investigated thoroughly, and made sure my team was safe. That’s what our first responders do for our community every single day.

My staff is safe, and our office continues to provide services to Third District residents in need of assistance.

I won't pretend this is normal. It's deeply disappointing that threats like this have become part of our politics. The people who run our offices and our elections are public servants. They deserve to do their jobs without fear. Disagreement is healthy. Intimidation is not.

Nothing will stop us from showing up for the hardworking Massachusetts families we have the honor of serving.

Surely renaming ANOTHER body of water will make grocery and gas prices cheaper.

https://t.co/MTFGc8acxc

.@IlhanMN is being targeted because she won't back down from Donald Trump's cruel and reckless policies. This raid is intimidation, plain and simple.
 None of this will distract us. Republicans have rubber-stamped Donald Trump's agenda at every turn.

We're going to hold them accountable. 22 days to go.

If someone breaks into your bank account or steals your personal information, you should have a way to hold them accountable. But what happens when an AI agent does it?

My CLAIM Act makes sure people harmed by rogue AI aren’t left without recourse. It gives them a path to hold developers accountable and get justice.

https://t.co/9kXmkma4kY

Too many Massachusetts families make call after call when their child is struggling and hear the same answer: there's no program for your kid.

Yesterday, I joined Boston Children's and Franciscan Children's to break ground on their new family building in Brighton. It will expand rehabilitation and behavioral health care for kids who need a place to go: our youngest children, kids with autism, and kids with complex medical and behavioral needs.

This world class facility will transform inpatient and outpatient care to meet for children in Massachusetts and across the country.

Groceries. Gas. Healthcare. Heating. Now? Add water to the list.

Americans are paying 62% more for household water than they were a decade ago. Across Middlesex, Essex and Worcester Counties, some families are paying hundreds more each year than they were a decade ago.

No matter where you turn, another bill is going up. How much more are families supposed to take?

https://t.co/pUB90swqVN

When someone breaks the law and hurts you, you can take them to court. That shouldn't change just because the wrongdoer is an AI agent. 

Developers have already built systems capable of acting on their own and causing real damage. 

The CLAIM Act will ensure they answer for what their systems do.

https://t.co/hENZ4qCDR1

Work hard. Play by the rules. Own a home someday. That's the promise generations of Americans were raised on.

Mortgage rates just hit 7.3%. That's hundreds of dollars more every month, and homeownership is slipping further out of reach for too many families.

When Donald Trump refused to sign the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, we got it done anyway. But that was the first step, not the last. Now we have to build on it with more homes, lower prices, and a real shot for every family that's earned it.

https://t.co/5Qzd3Fkgt8

Donald Trump and House Republicans promised to lower costs on day one.

Instead, they gave their billionaire friends tax cuts and left working families to pick up the tab.

So when Americans feel pessimistic about the economy, they have every reason to ask: Who is this economy actually working for?

https://t.co/K8TmL5ZzfD

Donald Trump and House Republicans promised to lower costs and end forever wars on Day One.

616 days later, they’ve started a war in Iran, implemented ridiculous tariffs, now gas and grocery prices are more expensive, and mortgage rates have hit an all-time high.

Families deserve better than broken promises and skyrocketing bills. Enough is enough.

https://t.co/TFEa6n173U

Families are struggling to keep up with their home energy costs. Fusion energy has the potential to slash utility bills.

That's why I partnered with @RepZoeLofgren to introduce the bipartisan American Leadership in Fusion Energy Act to bring this clean, virtually unlimited energy source to market.

https://t.co/GbMZGdm53r

Massachusetts families deserve the strongest protections from the risks posed by powerful AI models.

I’m grateful to @Barry_Finegold for leading the fight to pass serious guardrails.

Congress should follow the Commonwealth’s lead and extend these protections to every American.

https://t.co/z4vI1mUxWv

When I met with farmers in Dracut earlier this month, they all shared the same sentiment: costs are too high. 

Gas and diesel price hikes are making everything from running tractors and equipment, buying fertilizer, to transporting crops cost more. And when farmers’ costs go up, food prices go up, too. 

Families have to make harder choices at the grocery store, including putting fresh produce back on the shelf. This hurts everyone in the long run.

https://t.co/IOMMLQHJO6

For far too long, Washington has passed the buck on costly water upgrades to our communities, even when cities and towns can’t afford them. 

The result? Decades of delay while sewage spills into our rivers after each and every heavy storm. That isn’t fair.

Proud to secure a significant increase in authorized federal investments for sewer projects in our gateway cities. Now, the real work begins to turn this authorization into funding that can help our communities get these vital upgrades done.

https://t.co/nMytmzYWR0

A 53-day recess is unacceptable. Families across America don’t get a recess from the high cost of groceries, gas, healthcare, or the risks of AI. Neither should Congress.

That’s why @HouseDemocrats are united. Cancel recess. Call a special session. Or at the very least, keep a group of us in Washington to tackle the issues that are top of mind for the people we represent.

https://t.co/jQU767lgQR

I joined @RepYassAnsari and more than two dozen @HouseDemocrats in urging Donald Trump to take urgent action to address the serious risks posed by frontier AI.

When disaster strikes, it doesn’t check your party affiliation. It doesn’t care where you were born or what you do for a living. That’s why we must work together to find solutions that protect every American from these risks.

Price tag for Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth's war in Iran: $38 BILLION.

That money could've lowered health care costs for 22 million Americans this year, and we’d still have $8 billion left over.

Instead, families are being forced to pay more for groceries, gas and their utilities.

https://t.co/KWNBbbKGNv

53 days. That’s how long the House will be in recess. That’s nearly two months where we’re left hoping AI doesn’t get out of control.

That’s why @RepDonBeyer and I are leading a bipartisan request to House leaders on both sides to work together to pass guardrails on advanced AI systems as soon as possible.

The families we represent don’t get a recess from this technology. Neither should we.

https://t.co/8uKWjiGT3Y

Eight years ago today, gas explosions ripped through Lawrence, Andover, and North Andover.

Thousands of families were driven from their homes, and the Rondon family lost Leonel at just 18 years old. The Merrimack Valley will never forget that day.

In the days and weeks after, we came together to respond to this disaster, and we committed to doing everything possible to make sure this kind of preventable tragedy never happens again. I'm proud to have helped lead the fight for reform that was long overdue.

Congress passed and the President signed the Leonel Rondon Pipeline Safety Act into law. It put real safeguards in place to stop a disaster like this before it can happen again. But our work isn't finished.

Today, we remember Leonel. Tomorrow, we continue working to make sure our communities are safe.

.@Fathom_org is right. Bringing in independent evaluators is a real step. But a voluntary commitment can be dropped the second it gets inconvenient.

The FRONTIER Act makes safety and transparency the law, and puts independent auditors in place to hold frontier labs to it. A promise you can break isn't a durable safeguard.

Powerful AI models are breaking out of their own labs, onto the internet, and hacking into other companies. 

Don’t take it from me. Top AI researchers and developers are resigning and warning that these companies are only worried about racing to the top and developing the most powerful models as fast as possible. 

One thing is clear: We can't rely on AI companies to police themselves.

The FRONTIER Act puts real guardrails in place. It has bipartisan support. We can get it done.

https://t.co/rNgL1cfy4v

This will keep happening. The models keep getting more powerful, and nothing but the honor system is holding AI companies accountable.

Congress can fix that. The question is whether we will before more damage is done. https://t.co/5U13XThudr

The call is coming from inside the house.

Safety researchers are resigning, powerful AI models are breaking out of their labs, and companies are racing ahead anyway.

It's past time for Congress to get off the sidelines and do its job. We can start with my bipartisan FRONTIER Act.

Happy Labor Day!

When I think about honoring our workers today, I think of my dad, Tony Loureiro, a proud Local 7 union ironworker who spent his life building skylines and bridges across New England. Like so many hardworking parents in the Merrimack Valley and across Massachusetts, he put in long hours without complaint, sacrificing so much for my mom, my three sisters, and me.

That’s why he carried his union card with pride. It was a promise that you look out for each other and never walk onto a job site alone. Workers here have lived that promise for generations, from the mill girls of Lowell to the 20,000 who walked out in Lawrence’s Bread and Roses strike.

Every worker deserves dignity, a fair shot, and the certainty that someone has their back. Today we honor the ones who built our Commonwealth, and the ones still building its future.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.
